projects.title: Revenue Intake Pipeline (Cloudflare Pages → Workers → D1 → Jira)
projects.blurb: End-to-end revenue project intake: form submission routes through Cloudflare Pages and Workers to validate inputs, calculate a priority score, persist into D1, optionally store attachments in R2, and auto-create Jira tasks with an export-ready analytics endpoint.
metrics: Zero manual rekeying from form to Jira
Analytics-ready CSV export for Power BI
projects.outcome: Production-style intake→Jira→data pipeline that standardizes how revenue projects are requested, triaged, and analyzed, giving finance and RevOps a single source of truth for backlog and prioritization.
